_comment: Template for a doc-rag source list. Copy this file to <your-topic>.json in this same directory (that name is gitignored, so your topic never gets committed), fill in real values, then POST its 'topic' and 'sources' fields to /docs-ingest. See the doc-rag skill for the full schema explanation.
description: One line description of what this topic covers and why.

sources._comment_ecfr: type=ecfr fetches straight from eCFR's real REST API. heading_pattern '(?!)' never matches, correct for a single already-scoped section fetch like this one.

sources._comment_html: type=html fetches and converts a page to text. heading_pattern MUST actually match real section headings in that page's real fetched text (verify this yourself before shipping a source, a client rendered JS-only site will fail this check loudly rather than silently ingest garbage).
